info.name: Studio — assessment flow
info.description: Run all folders in order with Studio local environment selected. Every run creates three uniquely named demo users, a studio, two classes, and credit packs. Variables, future dates, tokens, and IDs are captured automatically. Expected HTTP 400/401/403/404/409 responses have explicit passing assertions. Authentication is per request. Expiry and concurrency edge cases are covered by the Django test suite; this collection demonstrates the synchronous main API flow. See README.md for startup and runner instructions.
